commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Metz can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

90+4' Pape Diallo (Metz) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The linesman points to the corner flag, Metz are going to take it.
90+3' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
88' It's time for a substitution. Julien Le Cardinal (Brest) comes on in place of Romain Del Castillo.
87' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Metz.
87' A cross into the box from Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) is cleared. Metz force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
85' Metz failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

85' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball goes behind for a corner. Metz will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
80' 4 - 3 Goal! The rebound fell to Georges Mikautadze (Metz) and he fired home from close range. The score is 4:3.
80' A loose ball is pounced on by Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Marco Bizot is alert and makes a comfortable save.
79' Laszlo Boloni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kevin N'Doram (Metz) replacing Danley Jean Jacques.
78' 70:30 – the latest ball possession ratio.
75' Arthur Atta goes off the pitch and Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) comes on.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Steve Mounie departs the field of play to be replaced by Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest).
74' 4 - 2 Georges Mikautadze (Metz) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and fires into the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
73' Lamine Camara (Metz) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Benoit Millot has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
69' Eric Roy has decided to make a change. Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) replaces Martin Satriano.
69' Here comes a substitution. Hugo Magnetti (Brest) is brought on as a substitute for Jonas Martin.
69' Today's match ends for Kamory Doumbia who will be replaced by Mahdi Camara (Brest).
66' The cross fools the defence and leaves Martin Satriano (Brest) with an easy chance inside the box, but he mistimes his shot and sends it just wide of the left post.
64' Laszlo Boloni decides to make a substitution. Ablie Jallow will be replaced by Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz).
62' Matthieu Udol (Metz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benoit Millot had an easy-decision to make.
60' 4 - 1 Martin Satriano (Brest) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the bottom left corner. The score is 4:1.
60' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) prepares to take a corner kick.
60' Kenny Lala (Brest) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. Corner kick. Brest will have an opportunity.
58' Wasted effort! Lilian Brassier (Brest) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range.
57' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.
55' Metz control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
52' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
50' Steve Mounie (Brest) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
48' Looks like Steve Mounie (Brest) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
47' Koffi Kouao (Metz) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Benoit Millot saw the whole situation.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Laszlo Boloni probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Didier Lamkel Ze. He is replaced by Pape Diallo (Metz).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+2' Steve Mounie (Brest) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top right corner, but Alexandre Oukidja has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' The Brest players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

38' 3 - 1 A perfect lofted pass from Martin Satriano finds Steve Mounie (Brest), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header into the right side of the goal. His effort was both strong and precise, and Alexandre Oukidja had no chance of stopping that. 3:1.
35' Benoit Millot blows his whistle. Fali Cande (Metz) commits a foul after dangerous play.
31' 2 - 1 Kamory Doumbia (Brest) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
30' The ball is crossed into the box and Martin Satriano (Brest) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the right side of the goal, but Alexandre Oukidja gets a glove on it to thwart him.
30' A quickly taken corner by Brest.

29' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) unleashes a shot goalwards from a mid-range free kick. The ball heads towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes a decent save to thwart him. Brest will take a corner kick.
29' 8:2 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
25' None of the Brest players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

24' The corner is swung in but Brest can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Brest will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
24' Kenny Lala (Brest) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The linesman makes the right call and Brest will have a corner.
23' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went way over the bar.
23' Brest have a corner.

22' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat. The ball goes out of play and Brest have been awarded a corner kick.
21' Brest get a corner. Kenny Lala (Brest) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
20' Benoit Millot has a clear sight and sees a foul from Arthur Atta (Metz).
16' Metz have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
16' Didier Lamkel Ze (Metz) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Now Metz have a corner.
15' The Brest players are exchanging some short passes.
12' 1 - 1 The ball slips through the box from the corner and Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) is standing in the right place to hit it straight into the middle of the net.
12' It will be a corner kick for Brest.
12' Steve Mounie (Brest) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play. Brest win a corner kick.
10' Brest take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
10' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Brest force their opponents to concede a corner.

6' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Lamine Camara delivers a teasing cross from the resulting corner and the ball falls into the space where Ismael Traore (Metz) is lurking. His bullet of a shot from close range goes low into the middle of the goal and it's 0:1.
6' Metz earn a corner.

6' Didier Lamkel Ze (Metz) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Metz.
3' Koffi Kouao (Metz) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
1' Fali Cande (Metz) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Benoit Millot blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Metz will take the kick-off.
Benoit Millot is the one to supervise the game today.
